record_title: Reversible Floquet obstruction in the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover oscillator
provenance: Exact reversibility, Liouville, and Floquet analysis applied to the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover oscillator and its explicit periodic family.
limitations: Does not determine the complete Hill-discriminant stability diagram, prove nonlinear stability of elliptic orbits, or independently establish the numerically reported attracting periodic orbit. General reciprocal-multiplier theory is classical and is not claimed as new.
